units.source_text: 再说，也许这是由于这种女人的天性，

en.t: Besides, perhaps this was due to the nature of women like them,

units.source_text: 也是她们始终保持着家庭意识的表现吧，

en.t: or perhaps it was also a sign that they had always kept a sense of family,

units.source_text: 她们就这样继续吃着一个个男人的残羹剩饭。

en.t: and in this way they went on eating the leftovers of one man after another.

units.source_text: 这种规矩不知是什么时候形成的，竟成了她们之间的不成文规定。

en.t: No one knew when this custom had begun, but it had become an unwritten rule among them.

units.source_text: 这种事，是她们的秘密，绝不向客人泄露。

en.t: This was their secret, and they never revealed it to the guests.

units.source_text: 就是在餐盘上也表现出水性杨花的，还是阿绢。

en.t: The one who showed her fickleness even on the dinner plates was still Ajuan.

units.source_text: 阿绢搬到上游那家旅馆以后，就是阿雪了。

en.t: After Ajuan moved to the inn upstream, it was Axue.
